title: Ned's Little Peg
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ch as k/sh, ow as oa.

pages.brief: A small cloth sock hanging loosely on an outdoor washing line.
The wind blowing the sock sideways on the line, nearly loose.
Ned the duckling spotting a small wooden peg lying in the grass below the line.
Ned the duckling picking up the wooden peg carefully with his beak.
Ned the duckling hopping up to stretch toward the washing line.
Ned the duckling clipping the peg onto the sock and the line together.
The sock now held firmly still on the line, no longer moving in the wind.
Ned the duckling stepping back, looking at the secured sock with pride.
Ned the duckling standing beside the washing line, calm and content.
Ned the duckling smiling warmly up at the sock now firmly pegged to the line.
